uutiset.t: Hong Kong Family Office Unwinds $3.9 Billion of Bets Around AI
uutiset.s: The Hong Kong family office launched by hedge fund veteran Larry Chen slashed its equity holdings last quarter as investors more broadly retreated from AI assets.

uutiset.t: Oil Traders in Talks With QatarEnergy for Long-Term Supplies
uutiset.s: Some of the world’s top commodity-trading houses are in talks to secure more long-term supplies of Qatari crude, seeking to build on their success at shuttling oil out of the Persian Gulf during the Iran-US war.

uutiset.t: Investec Profit Climbs as South Africa Unit Offsets UK Weakness
uutiset.s: Investec’s interim profit climbed as a recovery in its southern African business offset a slowdown in the specialist lender’s UK operations.

uutiset.t: The Path to a Year-End Stock Rally Looks Clearer After Anthropic
uutiset.s: Optimism is growing for a year-end rally once a series of major risk events that prompted equity investors to slash exposure is done.

uutiset.t: US Tech Stocks Are Set to Rally as Anthropic IPO Boosts AI Trade
uutiset.s: US technology stocks were set to bounce after a blockbuster reception to Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering revived confidence in the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.s: Razorpay Software Ltd., a fintech firm backed by Tiger Global Management, is preparing to publicly file documents for an initial public offering in India as early as next week, according to people familiar with the matter.

Taiwan Tightens Short Selling Curbs to Support Stock Market
uutiset.s: Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission tightened its curbs on short selling to help stabilize the local equity market, which is set for its biggest monthly decline since the global financial crisis in 2008.

uutiset.t: OKX's Lin Discusses Tokenization and Stablecoins Outlook
uutiset.s: Gracie Lin, Regional CEO for Singapore & Australia at OKX, discusses tokenization and her outlook for stablecoins. She speaks exclusively on the sidelines of Singapore FinTech Week on "Bloomberg: The China Show.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Australia to Allow Pension Funds to Offer More Targeted Advice
uutiset.s: Australia will allow pension funds to offer more targeted advice to their members as part of long-awaited changes to the country’s financial advice laws that will be introduced to parliament next week.

uutiset.t: Chinese Chip Design Stocks Sink on Concerns Over Foundry Access
uutiset.s: Chinese chip designer stocks tumbled on investor worries that their orders to overseas manufacturers may be turned away as the US tightens its regulatory grasp on technology.

uutiset.t: Philippines Returns to Retail Dollar Bonds as Peso Rebounds
uutiset.s: The Philippines raised more than $450 million from retail dollar bonds on Thursday, marking its return to selling such debt after three years as yields eased and the peso bounced back from a record low.
